lines: The authorities responsible for security in Senzaki have sent their thanks.
Looks like you did a good jobーShinohara Mari-san.
Mari had been summoned by Headmistress Asagi to receive a commendation for the incident from a few days prior.
A commendation for "single-handedly defeating a djinn that had suddenly appeared in the city of darkness, and saving its residents from danger."
For a Taimanin student still in training, it had been an extraordinary achievement.
I had heard about your talent and your gradesー
But it was a pleasant surprise to see you also do so well in the field.
For the students of Gosha, Taimanin Chief Commander Igawa Asagi was somebody they all looked up to with great admiration.
As she received such warm praise from someone such as her, Mari's heart wouldn't stop pounding.
I am relieved to see that the younger generation seems to be making steady progress.
Shinohara Mari. I think I will also ask you to participate in missions more actively from now on.
With that in mind, keep up the good work.
Still high on cloud nine, Mari left the headmistress's office.
Another thought immediately came to the forefront of her mind.
Defeating the djinn that had appeared in the shady city of Senzaki...
This had come about thanks to the cooperation of the wandering Taimanin Shinganji Kurenai.
The djinn dodged Kurenai's blades and countered with his cane.
After being knocked to the ground, Kurenai groaned as she got back on her feet.
...I see. It looks like it's not gonna be as easy as when we fought before, huh?
『Because at that time, I had already exhausted most of my demonic power.』
Floating in the air, the djinn answered matter-of-factly.
The djinn's power to "peer into one's mind"ー
Even with it, the djinn hadn't been able to react to Kurenai's attacks when his demonic energy had been waning.
『But this time it's different. Fortunately, I can replenish my demonic power as much as I want.』
『Even with you as my opponent, I won't be beaten that easilyー』
The djinn was still sucking the life force from the onlookers through his tentacles made of demonic energy.
Ordinary people had no resistance to anything "demonic." After they collapsed to the ground, all they could do was groan helplessly.
Mari had gotten up and called out.
Her legs were shaking with fear.
Having had her life force sucked out of her, her body wouldn't even move properly.
The djinn looking down at her with his ice-cold stare was far more intimidating than the Oni and gangsters from earlier.
Fuma Kotaro would never run away.
He couldn't even use Ninja Arts, but was still dealing with dangerous denizens of darkness like this.
『If you want to stop me, then you need to fight me yourselfーI believe that's what I said.』
...I'll fight!!! I don't know what you're thinking, Djinn-san...
Mari looked at the residents of Senzaki, who were groaning on the ground in pain after having their life force taken.
It was the Taimanin who protected those in need... those who suffered.
...Heh, good to see you so determined, Mari. Then I won't hold back either.
A demonic aura spread explosively from Kurenai's body.
She had unleashed the power that had allowed her to cut down the Salamander in a single strike.
I need your power, Mari. Will you help me?
Discussing it is pointless. That djinn is going to see right through it and everything will be for naught.
With his power to "peer into the minds of others," the djinn would be able to anticipate their attack.
Do what you have to do. As a Taimanin, you should know what I mean.
Keeping her explanation brief, Kurenai then leaped at the djinn.
(S-Something that I can do...? Against Djinn-san who even Kurenai-san struggles with...)
But, the answer was already decided.
It isn't really about having power or not.
If you know what you can do and what your friends can do, you will always be able to find a way to winー
(!! What Kurenai-san and I can doー)
Spurred on by Kotaro's words that she had overheard one day,
Mari slammed her fist into the ground with all her mightー!
Here I go, Kurenai-san!!! ーーーーEarth Art: Rending Fangs!!
In an instant, the ground opened up.
The earth rose up in the form of a snake and lunged at the floating djinn.
『A coordinated attack? That's easy to tell just by reading yourー』
That's it, Mari. ーーーMy vacuum blades tear all to shreds...
The wind generated by Kurenai's swords sliced through the earthen form, andー
what was one solid form then became an infinite number of smaller stones that went careening in the direction of the floating djinn.
The artificial sandstorm that transcended human imagination completely enveloped the djinn and tore his body to shreds.
The djinn's body shook violently, and then weakly fell to the floor.
His demonic power leaked out of the countless wounds the sandstorm had caused, and his body began to disintegrate.
『Fufu... Why are you looking at me like that, Mari?』
『I tricked you. Contempt and mockery is what I deserve...』
『Besides, you should be proud. You have vanquished a vicious monster that causes harm to people...』
『This is something that only you, an excellent Taimanin, can do...』
ーI see... I was indeed fooled.
So you put on this pompous act all for Mari's sake.
As Mari raised her head, Kurenai was standing next to her, her "demonic" power sealed again.
Hmm... I already thought it was a bit weird.
Even though you usually run away, you decided to fight after your demonic power was completely restored.
And even trying to incite Mari with your horrible actー
You wanted us to cut you down.
Hearing Mari's trembling voice, the djinn shot Kurenai a resentful look.
『Oh my... You're quite tactless, Kurenai. Even though I simply planned to fade away without a word.』
Pff, sorry. Letting the villain have his way just isn't my thing.
Kurenai shrugged her shoulders. With a small sigh, the djinn looked back at Mari.
『...I simply wanted to fulfill my original purpose.』
Y-You mean... to cause misfortune to people...?
『Fufu... I don't ever want to experience something so horrible as that again.』
『I was created to fulfill people's wishesー At least that is what I like to think. So...』
The djinn who could read people's minds had known Mari's wish.
How she had heard of the achievements of her friends and wanted to be recognized just like them.
To be recognized by the adults around her, as well as by one specific male studentー
『As far as I can tell, you are strong enough for that, Mari. The only things you need are confidence and experience...』
『In that case, I know just the right thing. An evil demonic creature that leads people to their ruin and must be defeatedーーー"Me."』
The djinn's power had a curse attached to it.
A curse that led those who had their wish fulfilled to ruinーHowever...
If the djinn fought with all his might and if Mari beat himー
Confidence and actual resultsーMari would get the two things she needed at once.
Th-That means...!? Djinn-san... you did all of this for me...?
Before she knew it, large tears were welling up from Mari's eyes.
『Fufu... That's what hubris does to someone, Mari.』
『I simply fulfilled my original purpose... At the very last moment, just one time... no matter how pathetic of a method it is...』
The djinn exhaled deeply in satisfaction.
His body was fading, turning to sand and disappearing into the airー
『Aahh... But still, it feels good... Thank you, Mari, Kurenai...』
『Having my first drink... together with everyone... I really... enjoyed myself...』
Huddled on the ground, tears were streaming down Mari's face.
In her hand, an old and decaying magic tome had been left behind.
That was the story of what had happened that night, from start to finish.
According to Kurenai, the people who had their life force sucked out would recover within a few days.
It seemed like the djinn really didn't want to hurt anyone.
You need to make it sound as if you alone defeated the djinn.
I can't let myself get too much attention, and besides, that is what he wanted.
Kurenai said to Mari and took the ancient magic tomeーthe djinn's original form, into her hand.
Well then, let's meet again one day, Mari. If you need help with anything, reach out to me anytime.
The achievement of defeating a djinn.
It was something that had been set up by the djinn himself and might not have been legitimate.
But Mari would just have to make it legitimate with her future efforts.
No matter how hard the mission or the battle might beー
(I am strong enough for that... Right, Djinn-san?!)
Mari smiled and nodded to herself, and took a big step forward.
Ah, there she is!! We already heard, Mari! You fought a super strong djinn, didn't you!?
Eh-he-he, Mari-chan, you're the talk of the whole school. As one of your school committee friends, Hebiko is also proud!
Hey, Mari! I heard you did a great job.
It was her friends Shikanosuke and Hebiko, and also Fuma Kotaro whom Mari secretly admired.
The "Book Djinn" is known as a legendary demonic creature. Let's hear how you fought it!
Y-Yes, of course! ーBut... there are also some points that I can't talk about...
(Uwahwah... N-No way I can tell them...)
(How I was able to do my best thanks to you as my role model, Fuma-kunー)
(I want to become like you. I want to be recognized by youー)
Uhm, let's see... I'm not sure where I should start, but...
And so Mari began to tell her story.
About the mysterious encounter and the sad farewell she had experienced that night in Senzakiー
About her own special adventure that she would never forget...
